subject: Quick technical check before full Redwood demo
messages:
From: Alex Morales <alex@brightcart.com>
To: dylan_brooks@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 09 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Quick technical check before demo

Hi Dylan / Marissa,

Thanks — we signed up for the self-serve flow earlier this week and ran a few smoke tests. Overall looks promising, but our infra/security lead wants a short technical triage (15 minutes) before we schedule a full product demo with your team. Main concerns are: VPC/private deployment options, KMS/HSM compatibility, and token retention policies when using your hosted API vs private deployment.

Can someone take a 15-minute call this week? We can do short windows around PST mornings (8:30–10:30) or late afternoons. I attached a tiny infra snippet that shows our current network boundaries.

High level use case: inference at 50–200 req/s for chat agents, need predictable latency under 200ms p95 for single-turn requests.

Thanks —
Alex Morales
Head of Integrations, BrightCart
alex@brightcart.com

Attachments: brightcart-infra-snippet.txt (text/plain)
From: dylan_brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
To: Alex Morales <alex@brightcart.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, dev_patel@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 09 Jan 2027 09:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick technical check before demo

Alex — thanks for the note and the infra snippet. Happy to run the quick triage so your security lead is comfortable before a full demo.

Quick options (all PST):
- Mon 1/11, 9:00–9:15
- Tue 1/12, 10:00–10:15
- Wed 1/13, 16:30–16:45

If none of those work, here's a 15-minute Calendly link to pick a slot: https://calendly.com/dylan-redwood/15min

Two quick asks so we can keep the call focused:
1) Is the requirement for on-prem or would a VPC/private deployment in your cloud provider suffice?
2) Can you share the top acceptance criteria for the integration (latency, throughput, data residency, audit logs)?

Looping in Dev (engineering) on the call — he can cover network and KMS integration. Attached a short pre-demo checklist we use for quick triage.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Sales Development Rep, Redwood Inference
dylan_brooks@redwood.com

Attachments: pre-demo-checklist.pdf (application/pdf)

Alex — Dev here, engineering on the inference side. I can join the 15-minute triage and cover the KMS/HSM and network topology questions. A couple things that would make the call most productive if you can share ahead:
- A short network diagram (AWS VPC/subnets, public/private gateways) or confirmation whether you'll be using our VPC/private deployment.
- Expected request size / max tokens per request and whether you plan to use streaming.

We typically cover: architecture options (hosted vs private), key management patterns, audit/logging retention, and a rough performance envelope for the model sizes you plan to run. If you prefer, I can share a one-page note after the call summarizing recommended configs.

Availability: I can do Tue 1/12 10:00–10:15 PST (works for me).

Cheers,
Dev Patel
Senior Software Engineer, Serve Runtime
dev_patel@redwood.com
